title: More than 20 apartments: 0.1 motorcycle/scooter bays per dwelling (Table 2.3a)
text: Motorcycle/scooter parking is provided on site in accordance with Table 2.3a. Table 2.3a Motorcycle/scooter parking²: Developments exceeding 20 dwellings to provide 0.1 motorcycle/scooter bays per dwelling. ²For each five motorcycle/scooter parking bays provided in accordance with Table 2.3, car parking bays may be reduced by one bay.

evaluator.label: 0.1 bays per dwelling, rounded to the nearest whole number with 0.5 rounded up

replaces.note: 20 or more dwellings, 1 per 10 car spaces -> exceeding 20 dwellings, 0.1 per dwelling

verified.note: Footnote 1 (rounding) is marked on the car and bicycle rows only, not the motorcycle row (p20); rounding applied by analogy. Footnote 2 cites 'Table 2.3' and its car-bay reduction has no resident minimum to reduce.

notes: new: no Chapter 3 equivalent. Applies to developments exceeding 20 dwellings (21 or more; current '20 or more'). verify: the rounding footnote 1 is attached to the car and bicycle rows, not the motorcycle row; the nearest-whole-number rounding is applied by analogy. Footnote 2 (one car bay reduction per five motorcycle bays) cites 'Table 2.3' (wrong ref) and has nothing to reduce for residents, as there is no resident minimum; whether it reduces visitor bays is unclear, so it is not encoded.
